purpose: One prespecified past-waiting protection candidate; known development and new synthetic validation remain separate
development_status: 36 previously observed environments; regression/development, never new independent validation
execution_order: rotate canonical four-arm order by scheduled environment index; actual branch executions follow the locked order
information_scope: Detached current accepted offers/current resource ledgers/priorities/travel; W1 ages are t minus observed request_t/search_start_t only. No pending replies, future resource releases, future patients or arrival-assessment schedules are supplied to the rule.
progression_rule: Development performance failure does not stop the single prespecified candidate's full new validation. Technical exception, audit failure or source drift aborts the entire run and preserves failure evidence. No selective replacements or reruns.

adoption_gates.scope: Evaluate each phase separately; new validation is the confirmation cohort. Pass means research eligibility only, never operational adoption.

priority_distribution.scope: Every profile separately and every experimental priority 4,2,1

regret_protection.scope: Overall phase and each experimental priority

threshold_interpretation: Experimental time-to-arrival thresholds, not clinically validated golden-time limits
reporting: patient paired maxima and success ID transitions
wall-time distribution and baseline retention distinct from solver fallback
actual arrival loss even at zero capped difference
inference: Descriptive finite-cohort eligibility gates; five environments per profile do not establish general superiority, equivalence, clinical safety or prevalence-weighted efficacy
operating_policy: unchanged server fixed_3 plus CP-SAT severity_first, 3 seconds; not a branch in this simulation

unavailable.resource_observation_delay: Current resources fully observed in the inherited engine
unavailable.clinical_outcomes: No clinical outcome model; experimental priority weights are not validated triage
unavailable.solver_fallback_rate: No CP-SAT arm; null. H1/W1 baseline retention is a separate statistic.
unavailable.real_road_efficacy: Synthetic routing only; separate road integration evidence is functional
unavailable.whole_resource_history_independent_repla: Recorded current-ledger and event audits do not independently reconstruct all resource transitions
unavailable.global_seed_history: Stored uncompressed local JSON scan only; raw gzip, deleted files, other machines and inaccessible history excluded
